question: Does searching the router's item name against chunk names help retrieval?
notes: Added in Stage 3 after the dev failure analysis: 11 of the 22 failed dev cases had a wrong or unusable Korean rewrite (퍼플라이트 for fluorescent tube, 참외 for pineapple, mixed scripts). The name list adds one ranked list to RRF: max cosine between the item name(s) (as asked, and the Korean rewrite if it passed the Korean check) and each chunk's item name (rag/retrieve.NameIndex). rerank-item adds the item names to the rerank queries (max over queries). The dense variants were added after E5 showed dense + rerank >= hybrid + rerank on dev.
